description: Apply IAS 10 (Events After Reporting Period) overlay to a prior calculation output. Classifies events as adjusting/non-adjusting, assesses going concern, generates adjusted journal entries. Most standards auto-trigger IAS 10 when subsequentEventDate + subsequentEventKind are provided — use this tool only for manual overlay or multi-standard combinations.

authorisationDate.description: Date financial statements authorised for issue (YYYY-MM-DD)

name: ifr_apply_ias10
